title: fhevm published package versions
description: The single authority for the version of every published payload, keyed by its npm-manifest.json package key. package.json versions are derived from this file by `fhevm-npm version apply`, never edited by hand.
$comment: This schema validates local structure. fhevm-npm additionally requires exactly one entry per `kind: published` payload, in manifest order, with canonical SemVer values.

packages.description: Manifest package key to canonical SemVer version.
